main-content.title: ✅ I already have the app
main-content.metadata: Cloud Softphone is already on this phone.

children.text: Your EPIC line works in Cloud Softphone, a free calling app. It takes about a minute.

**1.** Install **Cloud Softphone** - it's free

**2.** Come back to WhatsApp: on iPhone tap **◀ WhatsApp** at the top left; on Android press **Back**

**3.** Tap **Continue setup** below
Install the app first - your setup link only works once Cloud Softphone is on this phone.
This was a design preview of the EPIC install screen. Nothing on your line or account was changed, and no setup step was recorded.
